title: Measles, enteroviruses and other viral infections

steps.tx: **Measles kills by pneumonia with encephalitis**, not rash; **vitamin A halves deaths** in the deficient. **Mumps swells parotids with testes, ovaries, pancreas and meninges**. **Rubella ruins fetuses**, mild in kids. **Enteroviruses cause hand-foot-mouth, herpangina and aseptic meningitis**; **polio cripples**, EV-D68 weakens limbs. **Two-dose MMR shields all three**; **polio drops continue** till eradication.
steps.say: Measles was reported to kill by pneumonia with encephalitis, not rash, while vitamin A was reported to halve deaths in the deficient. Mumps was reported to swell parotids with testes, ovaries, pancreas and meninges. Rubella was reported to ruin fetuses, while staying mild in kids. Enteroviruses were reported to cause hand-foot-mouth, herpangina and aseptic meningitis, while polio crippled and EV-D sixty eight weakened limbs. Two-dose M M R was reported to shield all three, while polio drops continued till eradication.

steps.tx: **Fever with cough, coryza, conjunctivitis** precedes measles rash by days; **Koplik spots** on buccal mucosa seal it early. **Maculopapular rash spreads head-down** with high fever. **Parotid swelling with earache** with fever marks mumps; **orchitis often follows teens**. **Rubella adds postauricular nodes** with fleeting rash. **Hand-foot-mouth vesicles** with herpangina ulcers mark coxsackie.
steps.say: Fever with cough, coryza and conjunctivitis was reported to precede measles rash by days, while Koplik spots on buccal mucosa sealed it early. Maculopapular rash spreading head-down with high fever was reported. Parotid swelling with earache and fever was reported to mark mumps, while orchitis was reported to often follow teens. Rubella was reported to add postauricular nodes with fleeting rash. Hand-foot-mouth vesicles with herpangina ulcers were reported to mark coxsackie.

steps.tx: **Pneumonia with diarrhoea with otitis** complicate measles, especially malnourished; **encephalitis and SSPE** follow rarely. **Mumps meningitis** resolves; **deafness persists rarely**. **Rubella in first trimester** causes cataract, deafness and heart defects. **Polio bulbar disease** stops breathing; **post-polio weakens** decades later. **Enterovirus brainstem encephalitis** kills Asian kids fast.

steps.tx: **Measles IgM with PCR** confirms; **Koplik spots diagnose bedside** in outbreaks. **Mumps buccal PCR with serology** proves; **amylase rises** non-specifically. **Rubella IgM in pregnancy** decides management; **avidity dates infection**. **Enterovirus PCR in stool with throat** with CSF confirms meningitis. **Polio needs paired stools** for surveillance. **Vitamin A deficiency signs** (night blindness) worsen measles.

Mumps buccal P C R with serology was reported to prove, while amylase rose non-specifically. Rubella I g M in pregnancy was reported to decide management, while avidity dated infection. Enterovirus P C R in stool with throat and C S F was reported to confirm meningitis. Polio was reported to need paired stools for surveillance. Vitamin A deficiency signs with night blindness were reported to worsen measles.

steps.tx: **Vitamin A 200,000 IU daily for 2 days** treats every measles child over a year; **lower doses under one year**. **Supportive fluids with oxygen with antibiotics** only for bacterial superinfection. **Mumps needs rest with fluids**; orchitis gets support, not antibiotics. **Rubella needs isolation**; termination debated for first-trimester infection. **No antivirals exist for enteroviruses**; supportive care cures most. **IVIG saves immunodeficient** with chronic enterovirus.

Supportive fluids with oxygen and antibiotics were reported, with antibiotics only for bacterial superinfection. Mumps was reported to need rest with fluids, while orchitis got support, not antibiotics. Rubella was reported to need isolation, while termination was debated for first-trimester infection. No antivirals were reported to exist for enteroviruses, while supportive care cured most. I V I G was reported to save immunodeficient with chronic enterovirus.

steps.tx: **Outbreaks close unvaccinated schools**; **airborne isolation** contains wards. **Two-dose MMR at 12 to 15 months and 4 to 6 years** protects; **catch-up vaccinates** all unimmunised contacts. **Vitamin A for every case**, antibiotics only for bacterial superinfection. **Notify suspected measles at once**; elimination tracks every chain. **Polio AFP surveillance** reports every floppy child.

steps.tx: **Polio eradication nears the finish**: wild types 2 and 3 gone, type 1 corners in Afghanistan with Pakistan. **Inactivated IPV shields without reverting**; oral OPV seeds gut immunity but rarely reverts to VDPV. **Switch to IPV-only** where wild virus vanished. **Acute flaccid paralysis surveillance** catches every floppy child. **Adults bound for endemic zones** boost once. **Containment of lab stocks** guards the endgame.

steps.tx: **Rubella in the first trimester** causes cataract, deafness and heart defects in a quarter of fetuses. **Termination is debated** with counselling; **avidity dates infection** to guide. **Vaccinating girls before puberty** prevents CRS entirely. **Postpartum MMR** shields future pregnancies. **CRS babies shed virus months** and need isolation. **Surveillance pairs rash with IgM** in elimination zones.

Postpartum M M R was reported to shield future pregnancies. C R S babies were reported to shed virus for months and need isolation. steps.tx: **Exam traps:** Koplik spots precede rash; rash without them still tests. **Mumps orchitis is postpubertal**; prepubertal boys rarely swell. **Rubella mild in kids** still terminates pregnancies debate. **Antibiotics for pure viral exanthem** never help. **Single MMR never suffices**; two doses protect. **Vitamin A skipped** worsens measles deaths silently. **Polio in partially vaccinated** still paralyses; complete the series.
